content: We decided to analyse more closely those words for which the difference in the scores between lemma-based and token-based models was statistically significant. By `significant' we mean that the scores differ by more that one standard deviation (the largest standard deviation value in the two sets was taken). The resulting list of targets words with significant difference in scores is given in Table TABREF36.
